game: Ratchet & Clank Future: Quest for Booty
approach: Static recompilation of the PPU code to C with ps3recomp and of the SPU programs, HLE system libraries, Direct3D 12 RSX backend
help: Testing on real Windows with NVIDIA GPUs
notes: Early work, not playable: the game builds as its own Windows program on the shared runtime. In a scripted run it installs its game data, starts a new game, writes its save and plays the prologue's opening cutscene; play after it is not reached yet. Needs your own copy of the game and the decrypted EBOOT made from it; the build happens on your PC.
